summary: Launch One Acquisition Corp., a SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting an EGM where shareholders approved extending the combination deadline from July 15, 2026 to January 15, 2027. In connection, the Company entered Non-Redemption Agreements with shareholders holding 1,650,000 Class A ordinary shares, who agreed not to redeem and to vote for the extension. In exchange, Sponsor Launch One Sponsor LLC will transfer 330,000 sponsor shares to these investors. This is a common SPAC extension tactic to avoid liquidation and provide more time to find a target. Watch for a potential business combination announcement before the new deadline or further extensions if needed; risk-arb focuses on deal prospects and redemption pressures.
